author: Nintendo of America
description:
Check out Fortnite's Save The World, now free to play on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fortnite-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1064-01&utm_id=P1064-01 

Take on monster hordes solo or with up to three friends as you explore a vast, destructible world. In this epic PvE action-building co-op campaign, no two games are ever the same. 
- Build and Defend: Construct elaborate trap tunnels and towering fortresses to protect your objectives from relentless waves of monsters. 
- Loot and Craft: Scavenge the environment for materials to craft legendary weapons, from neon scythes to heavy-duty rocket launchers. 
- Level Up: Rescue, recruit, and customize a massive roster of Heroes from one of four classes—Soldiers, Ninjas, Outlanders, and Constructors—to suit your playstyle. 

Gather your squad and find your favorite gear! It's time to Save the World. 

#NintendoSwitch2 #Fortnite #SaveTheWorld

title: Fortnite – Save the World Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2

description:
PRAGMATA lands now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pragmata-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

From Capcom comes PRAGMATA, a new sci-fi action-adventure with a hacking twist and an emotional story. On their homeward journey, Hugh and Diana venture through the Lunar Research Station and encounter another child-like Pragmata named Eight, similar to Diana. What other mysteries await our duo on the moon?
